title: Bolt's Boogie
logline: A shy robot named Bolt overcomes its social anxieties to find joy and connection on a vibrant rooftop dance floor.
theme: Overcoming shyness, self-acceptance, the power of connection

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A small, metallic robot with expressive optical sensors, initially very shy and hesitant.

characters.name: Skylar
characters.one_line_description: A vibrant and friendly human, full of energy and encouragement, with a warm smile.

scenes.title: Rooftop Arrival
scenes.summary: Bolt arrives at a lively rooftop party, scanning the dancing crowd with nervous blinks, feeling overwhelmed and out of place.
scenes.setting: A vibrant rooftop party with city lights in the background, upbeat music playing.

scenes.title: Observing the Groove
scenes.summary: Bolt stands by the edge, observing various people and robots dancing freely. Its internal processors show a longing to join, but its body remains rigid.
scenes.setting: The bustling edge of the dance floor, neon lights reflecting.

scenes.title: An Invitation to Move
scenes.summary: Skylar, noticing Bolt's hesitation, approaches with a warm smile and an outstretched hand, inviting Bolt to dance.
scenes.setting: A slightly less crowded corner of the rooftop dance floor.

scenes.title: First Awkward Steps
scenes.summary: Bolt takes Skylar's hand and attempts a few stiff, mechanical dance moves, looking very self-conscious but trying.
scenes.setting: The main dance floor, surrounded by other dancers.

scenes.title: Finding the Rhythm
scenes.summary: With Skylar's gentle guidance and encouragement, Bolt starts to loosen up, its movements becoming more fluid and synchronized with the music.
scenes.setting: The heart of the dance floor, music volume increasing.

scenes.title: Dancing Free
scenes.summary: Bolt is now dancing freely, independently, and with genuine joy, its optical sensors glowing happily as it grooves with the crowd.
scenes.setting: A vibrant, energetic dance floor, everyone celebrating.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
